correctness.rationale: A1 has the log-concave positive binomial tail c_1..c_m; A2 tail sums are log-concave via decreasing binomial ratios. Convolution with (w+p)^2 preserves log-concavity, with a strict first inequality. Therefore all ratios d_{j+1}/d_j decrease and full coefficient positivity is equivalent to d1<1. Logarithmic differentiation gives d1=1+(m+3)/(2p)-mp^(m-1)/((p+1)^m-p^m), which is algebraically equivalent to p>p_m; equality leaves only the linear force coefficient zero. Exact rational independent checks across 42 sample cases m=2..8 supported the identities; uniform all-m proof is analytic.
